semantics.imp: Independent compact infernal rig with an asymmetric ember-and-old-gold bargaining flourish; its two-stage torn-plum wing chains remain unique to the Imp.
semantics.storm_simian: Independent broad primate rig with separate root-level left and right scapular storm-sail trees, each owning a root, leading spar, inner sail, outer sail, UVs, and mirrored-but-independent flight and gust animation.

authoritativeMappings.imp: Witchery Imp, with the Witchery Flame Imp page and image used only for high-level fire-demon cues

relationshipToExistingBoard.statement: This is a non-destructive Imp and Storm Simian revision. It does not replace or invalidate the already-frozen Hex Bat and Owl design references on the four-creature wave-03c board.
